description: A glass factory makes two types of glass panes: a regular glass pane and a tempered glass pane. Both require time on a heating and cooling machine. Both machines are available for a maximum of 300 minutes per day. It takes 3 minutes in the heating machine and 5 minutes in the cooling machine to make one regular glass pane. It takes 5 minutes in the heating machine and 8 minutes in the cooling machine to make one tempered glass pane. The profit per pane of regular glass is $8 and the profit per pane of tempered glass is $10. How many panes of each glass type should the factory make to maximize profit? What is the maximum profit?

MaxHeatingTime.definition: Maximum available time for the heating machine per day

MaxCoolingTime.definition: Maximum available time for the cooling machine per day

HeatingRegular.definition: Heating time required to produce one regular glass pane

CoolingRegular.definition: Cooling time required to produce one regular glass pane

HeatingTempered.definition: Heating time required to produce one tempered glass pane

CoolingTempered.definition: Cooling time required to produce one tempered glass pane

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing regular and tempered glass panes"

constraints.description: 3 * (number of regular glass panes) + 5 * (number of tempered glass panes) should not exceed MaxHeatingTime
5 * (number of regular glass panes) + 8 * (number of tempered glass panes) should not exceed MaxCoolingTime
The number of regular glass panes produced and the number of tempered glass panes produced should both be non-negative

RegularPanes.definition: Number of regular glass panes produced per day

TemperedPanes.definition: Number of tempered glass panes produced per day
